articles.title_en: Humanitarian mission in Alyoshki proceeds as planned, says Kremlin aide
articles.lead_en: Previously, Russia and Ukraine - with the assistance of US First Lady Melania Trump - agreed to a ceasefire in Alyoshki to allow for the delivery of humanitarian aid and to prepare for the evacuation of the civilian population via a designated safe corridor
